notes.title: Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

You probably guessed it by now - with the events of the last years I have sadly been unable to finish the map editor.

That said, the current build of R42 is free of known bugs and contains all content and features planned when early access was released plus the ability to record and share replays. After contemplating for quite a while I came to the conclusion that it is time to leave early access and release the game. If I get the chance to finish the editor in the future, it will be free dlc.

Thank you to everyone that joined us in the early access journey!

Stay healthy! Stay safe!

notes.title: Weekly Patch 09
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have a little treat for you (no tricks involved!).
The space select screen has been reworked and should be a lot easier to use now. We also included some settings and stats (ingame leaderboards!) for easy access.

One of those is especially interesting to our veteran players: a second speed setting.
In this mode your max speed as well as the effects of boosts are increased. You also have access to 3 manual boosts you can use on a button press. These refresh once you pass the finish line again.
Can you handle the new challenges this brings?

To accommodate for the higher speed and optional boosts we also reworked the player UI to better show your boosted speed and your remaining manual boosts.

As always let us know what you think on our [url=https://discord.gg/SCsdJJB]discord[/url] or community page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599479/0cf3a0e8513ed3cb7f3a2ce6cff0f20a4d95ca77.gif[/img]

Patchnotes:

- Reworked space select screen
- Reworked player UI

- Added high speed setting
- Added ingame leaderboards to the space select screen
- Added a second batch of leaderboards for the high speed variant of spaces

notes.title: Weekly Patch 06
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599479/59bd8bf46ad7070f1e7c6f4aa0bc22162a10e5c1.gif[/img]

The long lost Space 10 arrived! Don't get lost in data space while you try and master it's series of jumps!

Starting with this update AI will start the race with simulated progress. Why would they stop racing when you leave? Dataspace never sleeps!

Tell us what you think about it on our [url=https://discord.gg/SCsdJJB]discord[/url] or steam community forums.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599479/9b9df01308261c5f21bc46102d81b4f8abfe41f3.png[/img]

Patchnotes:

- Added Space 10
- Added UI showing the placement of participants at the end of a session (this does not apply to infinite sessions!).
- Added audio volume slider to options
- AI will start the race in a pre-simulated state. 

- Improved AI performance and ability to incorporate looping through dataspace

notes.title: Weekly Patch 04
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Space 12 is here! It's the first time players will be able to approach infinity without falling. What do you think about the ups and downs of this space? 

Let's see your times on the Leaderboards!

Patchnotes:

- Added Space 12
- Boosts are now colored differently for space 06 to make it easier to distinguish the 2 lanes

- Fixed timer precision error on newer versions of Windows
- Menu UI will try to detect the used VR system.

- Improved environment for space 07 and 09
- Improved performance in space 11
- Improved "first time playing" UI flow

notes.title: Weekly Patch 03
notes.notes:
Patchnotes:

- Added Steam Leaderboards (Spaces 4 and up will follow once steam updates)
- Savegames are based on the current steam user instead of the current OS user.

- The on-screen menu can be controlled by keyboard and gamepad now
- Improved performance of fade-in/out effects
- Space selection menu will remember the page you were on
- Control schemes can now be shown for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. Other HMDs will follow later.

notes.title: Weekly Patch 02
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This week space 11 made it into the game! (Yes 10 is missing for now).
I will not spoil much about this infinite tower. Instead I'll be looking forward to see how you 're going to approach it. Let us know your best time and tricks on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/SCsdJJB]discord[/url] or our community page.

Have fun!

Patchnotes:

- Added space 11
- Replaced the visuals for speed boosts.
- Fixed steam sometimes allowing you to start the game without first finishing to download all stages. 

- New players will be guided towards the control scheme menu on first start of R42
- Current version of the game shows in the main menu
- We shifted confirm buttons in the menu away from triggers as some users experienced problems with this. 
- Updated images for vive controls in control schemes. Other setups will follow soon.

- Slight improvements for AI pathing
- Improved AI spawning in
- Slight rebalancing of completion rate on spaces 04 to 06
- Adjusted tracking while in loading screens
- Improved environment for some of the first spaces.
